schema_note: Reg Deadline Wall data. Every entry carries a source_url and verified_on stamp. date=null means the regime recurs without a single independently-confirmed next-occurrence date this session — recurrence text describes the rule instead. Never edit date/recurrence fields without a fresh primary-source check.

entries.jurisdiction: OECD / Global (model rule; local implementation varies by country)
entries.recurrence: 15 months after reporting fiscal year end (18 months for the first / transition year a group is in scope). Date shown is the example first GIR deadline for a calendar-year MNE group's FY2024 transition year.
entries.who_files: Ultimate Parent Entity or designated Filing Entity of in-scope MNE groups (GloBE Model Rules Art. 8.1.6 / Art. 9.4.1)

entries.recurrence: Annually, by 30 April, national competent authorities submit the consolidated Register of Information to the ESAs (EBA/EIOPA/ESMA), per the ESAs' standing joint decision on reporting timelines. Entities file to their NCA on an earlier, nationally-set deadline (commonly end of Q1). Date shown is computed from the confirmed recurring 30 April rule, not independently re-confirmed as a 2026-specific published date.
entries.who_files: In-scope EU financial entities under DORA (banks, insurers, investment firms, payment institutions, etc.) via their national competent authority

entries.recurrence: Annually, by April 15, for the prior calendar year (23 NYCRR 500.17(b))
entries.who_files: Covered Entities under 23 NYCRR Part 500 (including limited-exemption filers), via the DFS Portal

entries.recurrence: Quarterly, due no later than 30 calendar days after the quarter-end report date (35 days for banks with more than one foreign office, excluding shell branches/IBFs). Date shown is the confirmed Q2 2026 (June 30, 2026 report date) standard deadline; the foreign-office extension for the same quarter is August 4, 2026.
entries.who_files: All FDIC-insured depository institutions filing FFIEC 031/041/051

entries.regime: FR 2052a Complex Institution Liquidity Monitoring Report
entries.recurrence: Daily for G-SIBs, Category II firms, and Category III firms with average weighted short-term wholesale funding of $75B or more; monthly for smaller Category III firms and all Category IV firms. Exact intraday submission timing (commonly cited as T+2, 3:00pm ET) was not independently reconfirmed against primary instructions text this session and is omitted.
entries.who_files: BHCs, IHCs, and FBOs subject to Category I-IV enhanced prudential standards (Reg YY/Reg LL) above the reporting threshold

entries.regime: FR Y-14A Capital Assessments and Stress Testing (Annual)
entries.recurrence: Annual, as of December 31. The exact submission-lag deadline (commonly cited elsewhere as early April) was not independently confirmed against primary instructions text this session and is omitted.
entries.who_files: BHCs, IHCs of FBOs, and covered SLHCs with $100B or more in total consolidated assets

entries.regime: FR Y-14Q Capital Assessments and Stress Testing (Quarterly)
entries.recurrence: Quarterly, as of the last calendar day of each quarter (Trading/Counterparty schedules follow a different as-of convention). The exact submission-lag deadline was not independently confirmed against primary instructions text this session and is omitted.

One-time mandate go-live; already in force. Administrative-fine tolerance period ran through end of March 2026 (the obligation itself was not delayed). B2G e-invoicing (orders over EUR 3,000 ex-VAT) has been mandatory since March 1, 2024.
entries.who_files: All Belgian VAT-registered businesses, B2B domestic transactions

entries.recurrence: One-time mandate go-live for taxpayers whose 2025 sales exceeded PLN 200M
entries.who_files: VAT taxpayers with 2025 sales over PLN 200M

entries.recurrence: One-time mandate go-live for VAT taxpayers not in the large-taxpayer or smallest-taxpayer bands
entries.who_files: VAT taxpayers below the PLN 200M threshold

entries.recurrence: One-time mandate go-live, deferred band for the smallest taxpayers

One-time mandate go-live. All French companies must be able to receive e-invoices from this date; large enterprises and mid-size (ETI) companies must also issue e-invoices from this date. This is the post-delay date superseding the original 2024-2026 schedule.
entries.who_files: All companies (receipt); large enterprises and ETI (issuance)

entries.recurrence: One-time mandate go-live for SME and micro-enterprise issuance obligation

entries.regime: Fedwire Funds Service — ISO 20022 structured postal address requirement
entries.recurrence: One-time compliance date. The fully-unstructured postal address option is removed; participants must use fully structured or hybrid address format with Town Name and Country always present.

entries.regime: Regulation CC funds-availability dollar threshold inflation adjustment
entries.recurrence: Adjusted every 5 years by the change in CPI-W (this cycle measured July 2018-July 2023, a 21.8% increase). Effective date shown is the most recent reset, already in force. Next reset is due around 2030; the exact date has not been announced by a primary source and is not shown.
entries.who_files: Banks and credit unions subject to Reg CC funds-availability schedules
